wire.t: The Champ (TJohn91) added Drew Lock (SEA) as a free agent on Thursday, with Lamar Jackson headed to injured reserve and the superflex slot a zero for two weeks. Sleeper lists Lock as questionable. Dude, Your Getting a Dell (Br0phy) added Baltimore rookie quarterback Joe Fagnano the same morning.

The only trade in the last week is still The Champ (TJohn91) sending Bucky Irving and Colston Loveland to Catfan94’s Farm Team (jrsmith1391) for Zay Flowers and Harold Fannin Jr. on Saturday. No new trades since, and OBJAY’s Gardner Minshew II claim from Wednesday is the last waiver move.

Lamar Jackson is headed to injured reserve and could face season-ending surgery, FantasyPros reports in its Nov 2 injury roundup. Jackson belongs to The Champ, which got 0.00 from him in Week 8 and now also has A.J. Brown (ankle and knee) ruled out.

Breece Hall was ruled inactive for Week 8 with a quad strain, but FantasyPros says he has returned to football activities and Week 9 against Kansas City is a realistic return target. Hall belongs to Catfan94’s Farm Team, which also has DeVonta Smith out.

Week 9 byes are Pittsburgh and Tennessee. That takes DK Metcalf, Jaylen Warren, Darnell Washington and Aaron Rodgers away from Hold My DK against Bourbon Lover. I Chase Brown Kids loses Cam Ward, Gunnar Helm and Carnell Tate, and The Champ loses Tony Pollard.
Jeremiyah Love (ARI) was ruled out after re-aggravating an ankle injury, per FantasyPros. Love is on The Champ. Tyjae Spears (TEN knee) and Emeka Egbuka (TB foot, Week 9 uncertain) are both on OBJAY.
Kyle Monangai (CHI) was ruled out in Week 8 with turf toe and Jake Ferguson (DAL) is out with an ankle injury. Monangai is on Asian Jim and Ferguson is on Kraft for Cash.

stories.title: LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix hangs 179.28 on Hold My DK and the 7‑0 is over
stories.dek: Catfan94 is 7‑1 and so is TheMoneyTeam2302. Dude, Your Getting a Dell scored 39.26, the lowest score in league history.
body: LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix beat Hold My DK 179.28 to 139.62, a 39.66-point win and the first loss for the former unbeaten. Josh Allen had 31.06, Brock Bowers had 29.7, Ja'Marr Chase had 28.6, Jahmyr Gibbs had 27.8 and Jordan Love had 27.52. Emmett Johnson had 26.3 on the bench. Hold My DK got 33.94 from Patrick Mahomes but Drake London put up 1.3 and DK Metcalf 0.9 in the lineup.

Hold My DK still has the 7‑1 record and the highest losing score of the week. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix is also 7‑1 and leads the league in points (1317.30) and all-play (74-14), and is on a four-game win streak.

OBJAY beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 147.28 to 39.26, the biggest margin of the week at 108.02. Br0phy's 39.26 is the lowest score in league history by 14.78 points, with Romeo Doubs, Zachariah Branch, Tre Tucker and Rashid Shaheed all at 0.00 in the lineup.

Bourbon Lover beat The Champ 153.98 to 105.44 behind Joe Burrow's 49.48 and Tee Higgins' 36.0. Jefferson’s Reserve beat Kraft for Cash 159.18 to 108.06 with Kirk Cousins at 35.18, Asian Jim beat StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte 119.76 to 107.16, and Catfan94’s Farm Team beat I Chase Brown Kids 119.96 to 115.88 by 4.08.
Week 9 is LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix against The Champ as a 24.5-point favorite and Hold My DK against Bourbon Lover, with Pittsburgh on bye.

stories.dek: Four starters at 0.00 and Stefon Diggs on the bench for 12.3. Br0phy is 0‑8.
body: Dude, Your Getting a Dell lost to OBJAY 147.28 to 39.26. The old league low was 54.04 from StonesOfBlu in 2024, so this one didn't just beat the record, it went through the basement floor. Romeo Doubs, Zachariah Branch, Tre Tucker and Rashid Shaheed all had 0.00 in the lineup.
Stefon Diggs had 12.3 on the bench and Jack Endries had 7.1. This roster is thin in a way a lineup can't fix.
Br0phy is 0‑8 with a 5-83 all-play and 648.38 points. That's 81.05 a game, and the next lowest team is StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte at 109.19.
Week 9 is Asian Jim as a 41.5-point favorite. Dude, Your Getting a Dell has never won a game in this league, and this is the best chance yet to put a number on the board that isn't 39.26.

rumors.t: TheMoneyTeam2302 has reportedly asked whether Pittsburgh's bye can be moved to Week 14. Sleeper said the NFL schedule is not a Sleeper setting. TheMoneyTeam2302 asked who sets the NFL schedule.
Br0phy has reportedly scored 39.26 on purpose to see how it feels. Witnesses say it felt like 39.26.
Catfan94 has filed an ethics complaint about Michael Penix Jr. for sitting on a bench for this many weeks. The complaint was filed with Catfan94, who ruled the bench is a state of mind.
TJohn91 has hired Tony Pollard as an assistant coach for the bench. Pollard has reportedly been seen drawing up plays on the whiteboard that start with 'Start me.'
Bill_Buttlicker has reportedly asked Marquise Brown whether he'd mind not being started either. Brown said he would take whatever role the roster gives him, which was a bench.
paknight12 has reportedly told Joe Burrow that 49.48 is a good start and the real goal is 50. Burrow said he'd think about it, and also that he'd like a raise.
jmello16 says four straight wins is a dynasty. Sources say the 46-42 all-play was asked to comment and said it needed a minute.
ManicOrientals reportedly celebrated the first win since Week 4 by dropping and re-adding the same running back twice. Sleeper said that wasn't a move, and ManicOrientals said it was a vibe.

TheMoneyTeam2302 loses Jaylen Warren to Pittsburgh's bye and Brian Robinson Jr. is on IR. BTaylor1 has Jonathan Taylor, Kyren Williams and Dobbins (27) at running back and 25-year-old Josh Downs is a nice receiver to add.
jmello16 has Travis Etienne Jr. and RJ Harvey on IR and needs a back. ManicOrientals has Omarion Hampton, Jaydon Blue (22) and Tyler Goodson, and Elic Ayomanor (23, taxi) is a receiver upside play.

ZachCarroll09 has six quarterbacks, and Cam Ward put up 30.76 on the bench in Week 8. jrsmith1391 has Baker Mayfield at -1.1 in the superflex and Keaton Mitchell (24) is a spare back. Ward (24) is the long-term piece.

Bill_Buttlicker has Jalen Hurts on IR and Drake Maye in the superflex, and wants a second quarterback for the long haul. Catfan94 has Josh Allen, Jordan Love, Malik Willis and Penix (26), and Denzel Boston (22) is a receiver he doesn't have.
The owner of 12 first-round picks and a rebuild trades a 24-year-old quarterback for a 42-year-old one who has a bye this week. Tyler is roasting himself. The bank is open, and so is the plan.
Catfan94 sends the best quarterback in the league to an 0-8 team for a receiver who had 0.00 in Week 8. Both of the league's commissioners would have to look away.
ZachCarroll09 sends a 24-year-old running back to a 5-3 team for a 37-year-old tight end. Bijan will still be good in 2030. Kelce will be in a podcast.

columnists.bio: Has never once lowered his voice. Writes from a basement shrine to Boston sports in pajama pants, fueled by Dunkin'. Believes every 4-2 team is either a dynasty or a disgrace.

columns.title: THE CHAMP ADDED DREW LOCK! THAT'S THE MOVE?
columns.dek: TJohn91 needs a superflex quarterback and got a questionable one.
body: DREW LOCK! SEATTLE! THE CHAMP GRABBED HIM THURSDAY MORNING WITH LAMAR JACKSON HEADED TO IR! TWO-TIME CHAMP, FREE-AGENT QUARTERBACK!
SLEEPER HAS HIM QUESTIONABLE, SO THIS IS A BACKUP PLAN FOR A BACKUP PLAN! TJOHN91 IS 4‑4 AND PLAYS A 25.5-POINT FAVORITE IN LIGMABROCKSANDLOVEMYPENIX! GOOD LUCK! YOU'LL NEED IT!

columns.title: 3 superflex tips from Holden McGroin, who watched Dude, Your Getting a Dell add Joe Fagnano
columns.dek: Br0phy is 0‑8 and still shopping at quarterback.
body: 1. Add a rookie quarterback from Baltimore. Joe Fagnano is on the roster now and he has never started a game for you. Neither has anyone else.
2. Start him anyway. The last lineup scored 39.26, so the floor is already installed.
3. Check the waiver wire at 8 AM like Br0phy and TJohn91 just did. Both teams were up early and both are looking for a quarterback. Nobody said it was a good plan.

columns.title: 3 waiver tips from Holden McGroin, who just watched OBJAY grab Gardner Minshew II
columns.dek: Dynasty is about the long game. Here is how to lose it slowly.
body: 1. Add a backup QB you will never start. Gardner Minshew II is on Arizona. That's the whole plan.
2. Drop a running back for him. Elijah Mitchell was just cut in Philadelphia, so running backs are clearly replaceable. I don't make the rules.
3. Check the waiver wire at 8:10 AM every day. Somebody did, and look what happened to them.

columns.title: Hold My DK and Jefferson’s Reserve are both running 0.82 wins ahead of their all-play
columns.dek: Catfan94’s Farm Team is the unluckiest team at 0.73 wins behind.
body: Hold My DK is 7-1 with a 68-20 all-play, which is 77.3 percent of all possible wins. Over 8 games that's 6.18 expected wins. TheMoneyTeam2302 has 7, so 0.82 wins ahead of schedule.
Jefferson’s Reserve is 5-3 with a 46-42 all-play. That's 4.18 expected wins and 5 actual, also 0.82 ahead. jmello16 has the same luck as the 7-1 team with a much worse team.
Catfan94’s Farm Team is the other way: 63-25 all-play, 5.73 expected wins and 5 actual. That's 0.73 wins behind, the most unlucky in the league. The Champ and Asian Jim are next at 0.64 behind each.
LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix is 74-14 and has 7 wins against 6.73 expected, only 0.27 ahead. It's good and honest. My model says that's suspicious. My model was built Tuesday.
